Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/ping.yml runs inline as jobs ping-go; without strategy: depend the trigger job passes when the child pipeline starts, so jobs that need it wait for its own needs only; a failed child job now fails the pipeline; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value can reach the scripts of the child jobs; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping-go job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping-go/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
